objectives: 機器學習與數據分析之統計方法已成為現今管院學生所必備的核心能力。本課程將教授如何運用機器學習與數據分析方法，並輔以 R 電腦程式語言撰寫，針對大量結構與非結構資料進行統計推論與預測。課程主要專注於經濟、財會、行銷等數據分析，期能將資料分析的理論與實務結合，並了解機器學習統計方法的應用。
content:
1. Introduction

2. Linear and Logistic Regressions

3. Forecasting

4. Cross-Validation and the Bootstrap

5. Regularization

6. Multiple Comparisons Problem

7. Classification

8. Factor Models and PCA (I)

9. Factor Models and PCA (II)

10. Tree-Based Methods (I)

11. Tree-Based Methods (II)

12. Experiments and Controls

13. Text as Data

14. Artificial Intelligence

15. Presentation

16. Presentation

17. Self-Direct Learning

18. Self-Direct Learning
books:
1. Taddy, M. (2019), Business Data Science, McGraw Hill
2. James, Witten, Hastie and Tibshirani (2021), An Introduction to Statistical Learning
